name: twitter_cm_starter
description: Alfred AI Twitter/X Content Manager — Starter. Posts 4+ original crypto/Web3 tweets per week. AI generates market insights, product features, educational content, and hot takes targeting your audience. Ideal for crypto exchanges and DeFi platforms. $5 USDC/day.

projectName.description: Your project or platform name (e.g. 'Backpack Exchange')

projectDescription.description: Brief description of your platform and key products (spot, contracts, stablecoins, etc.)

twitterHandle.description: Your Twitter/X handle (e.g. @YourProject) — optional, used for content personalization

contentTopics.description: Comma-separated content focus areas (e.g. 'spot trading,perpetual contracts,stablecoins,tokenized stocks,DeFi education')

targetAudience.description: Your target audience description (e.g. 'overseas Chinese-speaking crypto traders')

competitors.description: Comma-separated competitor names for positioning context (e.g. 'Binance,OKX,Bitget')

language.description: Content language: zh (Chinese), en (English), or bilingual. Default: zh

postsPerWeek.description: Number of posts per week. Minimum 4. Default: 4

twitterApiKey.description: Twitter API Key (from developer.twitter.com) — required for auto-posting

contentPlan.description: First week content plan with sample tweets
